segments.name: Steel wire reinforcing products
segments.description: Manufactures and markets steel wire reinforcing products for concrete construction applications, sold mainly to manufacturers of concrete products.
segments.evidence: Our concrete reinforcing products consist of two product lines: PC strand and WWR.

revenueModel.text: Insteel is paid by manufacturers of concrete products, and to a lesser extent distributors, rebar fabricators and contractors, for its steel wire reinforcing products.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products to a broad range of customers that includes manufacturers of concrete products, and to a lesser extent, distributors, rebar fabricators and contractors.

changes.text: In August 2026, Insteel announced plans to close its Upper Sandusky, Ohio manufacturing facility and consolidate its operations into its remaining WWR facilities.
changes.evidence: In August 2026, we announced plans to close our Upper Sandusky, Ohio manufacturing facility and consolidate its operations into our remaining WWR facilities.
